sources.name: Exponent.com people directory (site's own public search index)

caveats: This is the PUBLIC consultant directory; Exponent's 10-K FTE count also includes staff without profile pages, so levels differ from reported headcount (trends are comparable).
Seniority bands are parsed from bio text and cover only 7% of profiles; 'unknown' is shown for the rest, not guessed.
Practice-area labels are Exponent's own site categories.
